name: Extend UI
summary: Open-source React document UI kit: PDF/DOCX/XLSX viewers, citations, file system, e-sign.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 14+ document-specific registry items (plus many shared shadcn primitives in the same registry — excluded).
csv-viewer registry item; docs route is /docs/components/csv-tsv-viewer.
Heavy PDF deps (EmbedPDF / pdfjs) — peer budget higher than typical UI kits.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: PDF Viewer
components.summary: React PDF viewer with zoom, search, thumbnails, and text selection (EmbedPDF).

demo.peerNotes: Requires shadcn primitives in project; style-aware registry selects Base UI or Radix

components.copyCode:
# components.json registries:
# "@extend": "https://www.extend.ai/ui/r/styles/{style}/{name}.json"
npx shadcn@latest add @extend/pdf-viewer

import { PDFViewer } from "@/components/extend/pdf-viewer"

<PDFViewer />
